question:
**Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

He was supposed to ________ this work.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**do**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **homonym **is a word that shares the same spelling and/or pronunciation with another word but has a different meaning.
 
• "**Do**" is a homonym that can mean to perform or carry out a task or action.
